name: Can a small ceiling leak cause mold?

mainEntity.name: Can a small ceiling leak cause mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, even a small ceiling leak can absolutely cause mold growth. Mold only needs moisture, a food source (like drywall or wood), and a suitable temperature to thrive. Undetected or unresolved leaks create damp conditions behind walls and above ceilings, providing an ideal environment for mold to proliferate. Mold can begin to grow within 24-48 hours of water exposure, leading to potential health issues and further structural damage if not addressed promptly by professionals.
